topic: Changes in Solid Materials When Bent
key_concepts: Solid materials have definite shape, size, mass, and volume
Solids can be described by color, shape, size, texture, and weight
Solid particles are closely packed together and cannot move around
Solid particles vibrate a little but stay in fixed positions
Strong forces hold solid particles together so solids keep their shape
Matter exists as solid, liquid, or gas depending on molecular behavior
Bending a solid changes only its physical appearance
No new material is formed when a solid is bent
Chemical properties do not change when solid materials are bent
Some solid materials like plastic rulers and metal spoons can be bent
Bending solid materials can be useful in construction and crafts
